about.title: About Me
about.description:
I work at Tirasa, developing and customising identity and access management solutions with Java, Spring Boot, Apache Syncope and Apereo CAS. I started as an apprentice, learning through hands-on work alongside colleagues and with clients, including international ones.

I enjoy understanding how things work, solving practical problems and learning from the people I work with. In my personal projects, I also explore frontend development with React and TypeScript: this portfolio is one of the places where I practise and experiment.
